title: Mary we had in Ontario terrace
html_source:
A servant, Mary Driscoll who was employed by the Blooms when they lived in Ontario Terrace, Rathmines (Gifford).

Mary was part of the trial Bloom imagined in Nighttown (http://lit.genius.com/James-joyce-ulysses-chap-15-circe-annotated )when he was being accused of being a Don Juan.
